'''Corsair''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] where he was stationed at [[Edan Base]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Corsair was on base when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] performed an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. He flew his damaged X-wing out of the base hangar only moments before the hangar was bombarded by [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]].
